headline: Utley's two-out 10th-inning homer walks off Astros
recap: Chase Utley hit a two-out, solo home run off Dave Borkowski in the bottom of the 10th inning, lifting the Phillies to a 3-2 win over the Houston Astros at Citizens Bank Park.

Cole Hamels started for Philadelphia and worked eight innings, allowing two runs on solo home runs by Charlton Jimerson and Aubrey Huff while striking out eight without issuing a walk. Roger Clemens started opposite him and allowed one run over five innings, a bases-loaded hit-by-pitch to Jeff Conine that scored Shane Victorino in the fourth.

Ryan Howard also homered, a solo shot off Russ Springer in the sixth. In the top of the 10th, Rick White retired the final two Houston batters to strand the go-ahead run at third after a leadoff double and a sacrifice bunt, earning the win; Borkowski took the loss two batters later.
